summary: Completed comprehensive testing of POSEIDON time entry management system. All 12 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified critical bug fix (employees can see projects), cascade field functionality, and admin validation interface. Fixed a bug in ValidationPage.js where admin validation was calling wrong API endpoint.

issues: Project names showing as 'Projet inconnu' in the 'Heures par projet' chart - likely a data mapping issue where project_id is not being resolved to project name

action_items: Fix admin dashboard chart to show project names instead of 'Projet inconnu'
bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent: ValidationPage.js: Fixed handleValidate() and handleReject() to call /time-entries/validate instead of /time-entries/submit - this was preventing admin validation from working correctly

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all critical flows working, minor chart display issue)

seed_data_creation: Test entries created with prefix 'TEST_' for various status scenarios
context_for_next_testing_agent: All business rules for time entry status management are working correctly: draft/submitted/rejected are editable by employee, validated and admin-modified entries are locked. Cascade fields (Project→Discipline→Activity→Prestation) work correctly. Admin can validate/reject/edit any entry via the Validation page.

features_tested.critical_bug_fix_verified: Employee can see projects list on /time-entry page - FIXED
features_tested.edit_admin_modified_blocked: PUT /api/time-entries/{id} with last_edited_by set - CORRECTLY BLOCKED (403)
features_tested.cascade_fields: Discipline disabled before Project, Activity disabled before Discipline, Prestation disabled before Activity - WORKING
